t: You're looking at the tomb of John Tradescant and his family, dating from 1662, in the Church of St Mary, Lambeth. It commemorates two men of the same name: John Tradescant the Elder, an English naturalist, gardener, collector and traveller, and his son, John Tradescant the Younger, a botanist and gardener. The younger Tradescant died in 1662, the year of the tomb. Between them, father and son were gardeners and collectors, and this is the memorial that keeps their names in front of visitors.
